newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia says will support Peru in push for APEC.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia says will support Peru in push for APEC.

text.p: Malaysia said on Wednesday that it would support Peru's efforts to become a member of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) forum, the national Bernama news agency reported.

"We are sure that Peru will enrich our deliberations and contribute much to the common prosperity of the Pacific nations," Bernama quoted Malaysia's King Tuanku Ja'afar as saying at a state banquet to welcome Peruvian President Alberto Fujimori.
Fujimori arrived in Malaysia on Wednesday for a three-day state visit.
Peru is seeking to become part of APEC, which groups 18 economies from Asia and North and South America, and aims to have regional free trade by 2020.
The fourth APEC summit began in Manila on Wednesday.
Fujimori last visited Kuala Lumpur in November 1991. His latest visit is at the invitation of Malaysia's king.

During his stay, Fujimori is scheduled to hold talks with Malaysian Prime Minister Mahathir Mohamad on the promotion of bilateral relations, trade, investments, possible joint-venture projects as well as regional and international issues.

"I believe that our two governments intend to conclude some agreements to foster economic and technical cooperation in agriculture, primary commodities and land development," the king said in his speech.
